blend.description: Glätte den Wechsel zwischen tiefer und hoher Stimme
blend.label: Mischstimme

closure.description: Halte den Klang sauber und klar, ohne entweichende Luft
closure.label: Stimmlippenschluss

distortion.description: Kontrolliertes Raspeln - denk an Rocksänger, nicht an Schreien
distortion.label: Verzerrung

falseCordDrone.description: Leichtes Rattern der Taschenfalten - schwere Möbel, die über den Boden schleifen, eine ungeölte Tür, die zufällt. Ein tiefes MMMM zwischen M und R, wie ein Motor im Leerlauf. Nie der enge, hohe Bohrmaschinen-Klang.
falseCordDrone.label: Dröhnen, nicht Bohren

forward.description: Spür den Klang hinter der Nase, nicht im Hals
forward.label: Vorderer Sitz

fryOnset.description: Beginne auf einem leicht komprimierten Fry und löse dann den Einsatz. Dieses Lösen schließt die Stimmlippen wie einen Reißverschluss.
fryOnset.label: Fry-Einsatz

grit.description: Gib eine raue Kante dazu - wie ein leises Knurren darunter
grit.label: Rauheit

hotAir.description: Atme aus, als würdest du dir an einem kalten Tag die Hände wärmen. Jede Screaming-Technik braucht das.
hotAir.label: Warme Luft

light.description: Nimm deine weichere, höhere Stimme - nicht drücken
light.label: Leicht & sanft

lowLarynx.description: Halte den Kehlkopf unten und locker. Wenn er hochsteigt, hast du das Register gewechselt, statt es zu erreichen.
lowLarynx.label: Tiefer Kehlkopf

noNasalAir.description: Nichts durch die Nase. Halte sie kurz zu - der Klang darf sich überhaupt nicht ändern.
noNasalAir.label: Keine Nasenluft

open.description: Lass den Kiefer fallen, wie beim Gähnen im Singen
open.label: Offener Sitz

pokerFace.description: Ausdrucksloses, entspanntes Gesicht. Ein verkrampftes Gesicht heißt, dass auch der Hals presst.
pokerFace.label: Pokerface

power.description: Sing lauter aus dem Bauch, nicht durch Druck im Hals
power.label: Kraft

quack.description: Eine quietschende, fast würgende Absicht - aber der Kehlkopf bleibt unten. Es geht um die Absicht, nicht um das Geräusch.
quack.label: Quaken

sovt.description: Sing durch ein sanftes Summen - wie durch einen Strohhalm
sovt.label: Resonanz

steadySupport.description: Entspannte Bauchatmung mit leichtem Druck nach unten. Stabil, aber nie verriegelt oder verspannt.
steadySupport.label: Ruhige Stütze

sustain.description: Halte jeden Ton ruhig über die volle Länge
sustain.label: Atemkontrolle

tryInhaled.description: Finde es erst beim Einatmen. Dieses Gefühl nimmst du mit in die ausgeatmete Version.
tryInhaled.label: Versuch: eingeatmet

tryOctaveUp.description: Ziel auf den Ton eine Oktave darüber und lass ihn dann in die Subharmonische sinken. Ein Einstieg, nichts zum Halten.
tryOctaveUp.label: Versuch: Oktave höher

vocalFry.description: Dieser knarrende, tiefe Klang - als würde die Stimme aufwachen
vocalFry.label: Vocal Fry

breakFinder.firstBreakExplain: Sing mit dem Klavier mit. Wenn deine Stimme kippen will, in einen leichteren Klang umschlägt oder du plötzlich mehr drücken musst, dann ist es so weit. Tippe irgendwo auf den Bildschirm.
breakFinder.tapWhenYouFeel: Tippe, wenn du den Wechsel spürst
breakFinder.thisHelpsEstimate: Damit schätzen wir deinen zweiten Registerübergang.
breakFinder.voiceBreakEducational: Dein Stimmfach hängt auch davon ab, wo deine Stimme am besten klingt, und von deiner Klangfarbe.
breakFinder.voiceBreakExplain: Wenn du höher singst, gibt es eine Stelle, an der die Stimme kippen oder umschalten will, wie ein Gangwechsel. Das ist dein Registerbruch. Wir spielen Töne aufwärts. Sing einfach mit und tippe auf den Bildschirm, wenn du diesen Wechsel spürst.
breakFinder.whatDescribesYourVoice: Was beschreibt deine Stimme am besten?

listenFor.suddenlyNeedMoreEffort: Du brauchst plötzlich mehr Kraft, um höher zu singen
listenFor.voiceFlipsToLighterSound: Deine Stimme kippt in einen leichteren, behauchten Klang
listenFor.voiceWantsToCrack: Deine Stimme will kippen oder brechen

range.goAsHighAsYouCan: Geh so hoch, wie es bequem geht
range.holdUntilCalm: Halte den Ton, bis die Wellen ruhig werden
range.listenForNotes: Wir hören erst auf deinen tiefsten Ton, dann auf den höchsten. Sing einfach und halte jeden Ton ruhig.
range.mainRangeIsChestAndHead: Das sind deine Brust- und Kopfstimme - die Töne, die du normal singst.
range.rangeBreakMoreReliable: Dein Registerbruch sagt zuverlässiger etwas über dein Stimmfach.
range.rangeMayChange: Dein Umfang ändert sich mit Einsingen, Training und Tageszeit.
range.voiceBreakOnboardingDesc: Damit bauen wir Übungen um deine Registerübergänge herum.
range.wantToFindVoiceBreak: Willst du auch deinen Registerbruch finden?

registers.subharmonicSoundingNote: Das sind die Töne, die andere hören, nicht die, die du singst. Tippe auf die Lautsprecher, um sie zu hören.

blend.description: Smooth out the shift between your low and high voice
blend.label: Mix

closure.description: Keep the sound clean and clear, no air leaking out
closure.label: Cord Closure

distortion.description: Controlled rasp - think rock singer, not shouting
distortion.label: Distortion

falseCordDrone.description: Light false-cord rattle - heavy furniture dragging, an unoiled door swinging shut. A low MMMM between M and R, like an idling motor. Never the tight, high power-drill sound.
falseCordDrone.label: Drone, not drill

forward.description: Feel the sound behind your nose, not in your throat
forward.label: Forward Placement

fryOnset.description: Start on a lightly compressed fry, then release the attack. That release is what zips the folds.
fryOnset.label: Fry onset

grit.description: Add a raspy edge - like a quiet growl underneath
grit.label: Grit

hotAir.description: Breathe out like you are warming your hands on a cold day. Every screaming technique needs this.
hotAir.label: Hot air

light.description: Use your softer, higher voice - don't push
light.label: Light & Gentle

lowLarynx.description: Keep the larynx down and relaxed. If it climbs, you have swapped registers rather than reached one.
lowLarynx.label: Low larynx

noNasalAir.description: Nothing through the nose. Pinch it shut for a second - the sound should not change at all.
noNasalAir.label: No nasal air

open.description: Drop your jaw, like you're yawning while singing
open.label: Open Placement

pokerFace.description: Blank, relaxed expression. Squeezing the face is a sign the throat is squeezing too.
pokerFace.label: Poker face

power.description: Sing louder from your belly, not by squeezing your throat
power.label: Power

quack.description: A squeaky, almost gagging intention - but with the larynx staying down. The intention is the point, not the noise.
quack.label: Quack

sovt.description: Sing through a gentle buzz - like humming through a straw
sovt.label: Resonance

steadySupport.description: Relaxed belly breathing with gentle downward pressure. Stable, but never locked or braced.
steadySupport.label: Steady support

sustain.description: Hold each note steady for its full length
sustain.label: Breath Control

tryInhaled.description: Find it breathing in first. That sensation is what you carry back to the exhaled version.
tryInhaled.label: Try: inhaled

tryOctaveUp.description: Aim for the note an octave above, then relax it down into the subharmonic. A way in, not something to hold.
tryOctaveUp.label: Try: octave up

vocalFry.description: That crackly, low sound - like your voice waking up
vocalFry.label: Vocal Fry

breakFinder.firstBreakExplain: Sing along with the piano. When your voice feels like it wants to crack, flip to a lighter sound, or you have to push harder - that's it. Tap anywhere on screen.
breakFinder.tapWhenYouFeel: Tap when you feel the shift
breakFinder.thisHelpsEstimate: This helps us estimate your second register transition.
breakFinder.voiceBreakEducational: Voice type also depends on where your voice sounds best and your tone quality.
breakFinder.voiceBreakExplain: As you sing higher, there's a spot where your voice wants to crack or shift - like switching gears. That's your voice break. We'll play notes going up. Just sing along and tap the screen when you feel that shift happen.

listenFor.suddenlyNeedMoreEffort: You suddenly need more effort to sing higher
listenFor.voiceFlipsToLighterSound: Your voice flips to a lighter, breathier sound
listenFor.voiceWantsToCrack: Your voice wants to crack or break

range.goAsHighAsYouCan: Go as high as you comfortably can
range.holdUntilCalm: Hold the note until the waves calm down
range.listenForNotes: We'll listen for your lowest note, then your highest. Just sing and hold each note steady.
range.mainRangeIsChestAndHead: This is your chest and head voice - the notes you sing normally.
range.rangeBreakMoreReliable: Your voice break is a more reliable indicator of voice type.
range.rangeMayChange: Your range may change with warmup, training, and time of day.
range.rangeTooNarrow: That seems too narrow - try again?
range.voiceBreakOnboardingDesc: This helps build exercises around your register transitions.
range.wantToFindVoiceBreak: Want to find your voice break too?

registers.subharmonicSoundingNote: These are the notes people hear, not the ones you sing. Tap the speakers to hear each one.

blend.description: Suaviza el cambio entre tu voz baja y alta
blend.label: Mezcla

closure.description: Mantén el sonido limpio y claro, sin escape de aire
closure.label: Cierre Glótico

distortion.description: Aspereza controlada - piensa en rockero, no en gritar
distortion.label: Distorsión

falseCordDrone.description: Vibración ligera de las bandas ventriculares: un mueble arrastrándose, una puerta sin aceitar cerrándose. Un MMMM grave entre M y R, como un motor al ralentí. Nunca el sonido agudo y apretado de un taladro.
falseCordDrone.label: Zumbido, no taladro

forward.description: Siente el sonido detrás de tu nariz, no en la garganta
forward.label: Colocación Frontal

fryOnset.description: Empieza con un fry ligeramente comprimido y suelta el ataque. Esa soltura es lo que cierra las cuerdas como una cremallera.
fryOnset.label: Ataque en fry

grit.description: Agrega un borde áspero - como un gruñido suave por debajo
grit.label: Rasgado

hotAir.description: Suelta el aire como si te calentaras las manos en un día frío. Toda técnica de scream lo necesita.
hotAir.label: Aire caliente

light.description: Usa tu voz suave y alta - no empujes
light.label: Suave y Ligero

lowLarynx.description: Mantén la laringe baja y relajada. Si sube, has cambiado de registro en vez de alcanzarlo.
lowLarynx.label: Laringe baja

noNasalAir.description: Nada de aire por la nariz. Tápatela un segundo: el sonido no debería cambiar nada.
noNasalAir.label: Sin aire nasal

open.description: Deja caer la mandíbula, como bostezando mientras cantas
open.label: Colocación Abierta

pokerFace.description: Expresión relajada y neutra. Apretar la cara indica que la garganta también está apretando.
pokerFace.label: Cara neutra

power.description: Canta más fuerte desde el abdomen, no apretando la garganta
power.label: Potencia

quack.description: Intención chillona, casi de arcada, pero con la laringe abajo. Lo importante es la intención, no el ruido.
quack.label: Cuack

sovt.description: Canta con un zumbido suave - como tararear a través de un popote
sovt.label: Resonancia

steadySupport.description: Respiración abdominal relajada con presión suave hacia abajo. Estable, pero nunca bloqueado.
steadySupport.label: Apoyo estable

sustain.description: Mantén cada nota firme durante toda su duración
sustain.label: Control de Aire

tryInhaled.description: Encuéntralo primero inhalando. Esa sensación es la que llevas a la versión exhalada.
tryInhaled.label: Prueba: inhalando

tryOctaveUp.description: Apunta a la nota una octava por encima y relájala hacia el subarmónico. Es una vía de entrada, no algo que mantener.
tryOctaveUp.label: Prueba: octava arriba

vocalFry.description: Ese sonido crepitante y grave - como tu voz despertando
vocalFry.label: Vocal Fry

breakFinder.firstBreakExplain: Canta junto al piano. Cuando tu voz sienta que quiere quebrarse, cambiar a un sonido más ligero, o tengas que hacer más esfuerzo - eso es. Toca cualquier parte de la pantalla.
breakFinder.thisHelpsEstimate: Esto nos ayuda a estimar tu segunda transición de registro.
breakFinder.voiceBreakEducational: El tipo de voz también depende de dónde suena mejor tu voz y tu calidad tonal.
breakFinder.voiceBreakExplain: Al cantar más agudo, hay un punto donde tu voz quiere quebrarse o cambiar - como cambiar de marcha. Ese es tu quiebre vocal. Tocaremos notas subiendo. Solo canta junto al piano y toca la pantalla cuando sientas ese cambio.

listenFor.suddenlyNeedMoreEffort: De repente necesitas más esfuerzo para cantar más agudo
listenFor.voiceFlipsToLighterSound: Tu voz cambia a un sonido más ligero y aireado
listenFor.voiceWantsToCrack: Tu voz quiere quebrarse o romperse

range.goAsHighAsYouCan: Sube tan alto como puedas cómodamente
range.holdUntilCalm: Mantén la nota hasta que las ondas se calmen
range.listenForNotes: Escucharemos tu nota más grave, luego la más aguda. Solo canta y mantén cada nota firme.
range.mainRangeIsChestAndHead: Es tu voz de pecho y de cabeza - las notas que cantas normalmente.
range.nowSingHighest: Ahora canta tu nota más aguda
range.rangeBreakMoreReliable: Tu quiebre vocal es un indicador más confiable del tipo de voz.
range.rangeMayChange: Tu rango puede cambiar con el calentamiento, el entrenamiento y la hora del día.
range.singHighestNote: Canta tu nota más aguda cómoda
range.singLowestNote: Canta tu nota más grave cómoda
range.voiceBreakOnboardingDesc: Esto ayuda a construir ejercicios alrededor de tus transiciones de registro.

registers.subharmonicSoundingNote: Son las notas que se oyen, no las que cantas. Toca los altavoces para escuchar cada una.

smooth.description: Conecta las notas con un desliz.
smooth.name: Suave

blend.description: Adoucis le passage entre ta voix grave et ta voix aiguë
blend.label: Voix mixte

closure.description: Garde un son net et clair, sans fuite d'air
closure.label: Fermeture des cordes

distortion.description: Rocaille contrôlée, pense chanteur de rock, pas cri
distortion.label: Distorsion

falseCordDrone.description: Vibration légère des bandes ventriculaires : un meuble qu'on traîne, une porte non huilée qui se referme. Un MMMM grave entre M et R, comme un moteur au ralenti. Jamais le son aigu et serré d'une perceuse.
falseCordDrone.label: Bourdon, pas perceuse

forward.description: Sens le son derrière ton nez, pas dans la gorge
forward.label: Placement avant

fryOnset.description: Commence sur un fry légèrement comprimé, puis relâche l'attaque. C'est ce relâchement qui ferme les plis.
fryOnset.label: Attaque en fry

grit.description: Ajoute un peu de rocaille, comme un grognement discret en dessous
grit.label: Grain

hotAir.description: Souffle comme pour réchauffer tes mains par temps froid. Toute technique de scream en a besoin.
hotAir.label: Air chaud

light.description: Utilise ta voix plus douce et plus haute, ne pousse pas
light.label: Léger et doux

lowLarynx.description: Garde le larynx bas et détendu. S'il monte, tu as changé de registre au lieu de l'atteindre.
lowLarynx.label: Larynx bas

noNasalAir.description: Rien par le nez. Pince-le une seconde : le son ne doit pas changer du tout.
noNasalAir.label: Pas d'air nasal

open.description: Descends la mâchoire, comme si tu bâillais en chantant
open.label: Placement ouvert

pokerFace.description: Expression détendue et neutre. Serrer le visage signale que la gorge serre aussi.
pokerFace.label: Visage neutre

power.description: Chante plus fort depuis le ventre, pas en serrant la gorge
power.label: Puissance

quack.description: Une intention criarde, presque de haut-le-cœur, mais le larynx reste bas. C'est l'intention qui compte, pas le bruit.
quack.label: Couac

sovt.description: Chante à travers un léger bourdonnement, comme si tu fredonnais dans une paille
sovt.label: Résonance

steadySupport.description: Respiration ventrale détendue avec une légère pression vers le bas. Stable, jamais bloqué.
steadySupport.label: Soutien stable

sustain.description: Tiens chaque note bien stable sur toute sa durée
sustain.label: Contrôle du souffle

tryInhaled.description: Trouve-le d'abord en inspirant. C'est cette sensation que tu ramènes vers la version expirée.
tryInhaled.label: Essaie : en inspirant

tryOctaveUp.description: Vise la note à l'octave supérieure, puis détends-la vers le subharmonique. Une porte d'entrée, pas quelque chose à tenir.
tryOctaveUp.label: Essaie : octave au-dessus

vocalFry.description: Ce son grave et craquant, comme une voix qui se réveille
vocalFry.label: Friture vocale

breakFinder.firstBreakExplain: Chante avec le piano. Quand ta voix veut casser, qu'elle bascule vers un son plus léger ou que tu dois pousser davantage, c'est là. Touche n'importe où sur l'écran.
breakFinder.tapWhenYouFeel: Touche l'écran quand tu sens le changement
breakFinder.thisHelpsEstimate: Cela nous aide à estimer ta deuxième transition de registre.
breakFinder.voiceBreakEducational: Le type de voix dépend aussi de la zone où ta voix sonne le mieux et de ton timbre.
breakFinder.voiceBreakExplain: En montant, il y a un endroit où ta voix veut casser ou changer, comme un changement de vitesse. C'est ton passage de voix. On va jouer des notes qui montent. Chante avec et touche l'écran quand tu sens ce changement.
breakFinder.whatDescribesYourVoice: Qu'est-ce qui décrit le mieux ta voix ?
breakFinder.youFeltSomethingAround: Tu as senti quelque chose vers {note}

listenFor.suddenlyNeedMoreEffort: Il te faut soudain plus d'effort pour monter
listenFor.voiceFlipsToLighterSound: Ta voix bascule vers un son plus léger et soufflé
listenFor.voiceWantsToCrack: Ta voix veut casser ou dérailler

fullJourney.description: S'échauffer jusqu'à la voix de tête
fullJourney.name: Parcours complet

targetZona.description: Se centrer sur la zone de passage
targetZona.name: Cibler la zone de passage

range.goAsHighAsYouCan: Monte aussi haut que tu le peux confortablement
range.holdUntilCalm: Tiens la note jusqu'à ce que les ondes se calment
range.listenForNotes: On va écouter ta note la plus grave, puis la plus aiguë. Chante et tiens chaque note bien stable.
range.mainRangeIsChestAndHead: C'est ta voix de poitrine et de tête - les notes que tu chantes normalement.
range.rangeBreakMoreReliable: Ton passage de voix est un indicateur plus fiable du type de voix.
range.rangeMayChange: Ta tessiture peut varier selon l'échauffement, l'entraînement et l'heure de la journée.
range.rangeTooNarrow: Cela semble trop étroit - on réessaie ?
range.singHighestNote: Chante ta note aiguë la plus confortable
range.singLowestNote: Chante ta note grave la plus confortable
range.voiceBreakOnboardingDesc: Cela permet de construire les exercices autour de tes transitions de registre.
range.wantToFindVoiceBreak: Tu veux aussi trouver ton passage de voix ?

registers.subharmonicSoundingNote: Ce sont les notes qu'on entend, pas celles que tu chantes. Touche les haut-parleurs pour entendre chacune.

smooth.description: Relie les notes par un glissé.
smooth.name: Lié

blend.description: Haluskan perpindahan antara suara rendah dan tinggimu
blend.label: Mix

closure.description: Jaga bunyinya bersih dan jernih, tanpa udara yang bocor
closure.label: Pita Suara Rapat

distortion.description: Serak terkendali - bayangkan penyanyi rock, bukan berteriak
distortion.label: Distorsi

falseCordDrone.description: Getar pita suara palsu yang ringan - perabot berat diseret, pintu tanpa oli yang menutup. MMMM rendah antara M dan R, seperti mesin yang menyala pelan. Jangan sampai jadi bunyi bor listrik yang tinggi dan tegang.
falseCordDrone.label: Dengung, bukan bor

forward.description: Rasakan bunyinya di belakang hidung, bukan di tenggorokan
forward.label: Penempatan Depan

fryOnset.description: Mulai dari fry yang sedikit terkompresi, lalu lepas awal nadanya. Pelepasan itulah yang merapatkan pita suaramu.
fryOnset.label: Awalan fry

grit.description: Tambahkan sedikit serak - seperti geraman pelan di bawahnya
grit.label: Serak

hotAir.description: Embuskan napas seperti sedang menghangatkan tangan di hari dingin. Setiap teknik screaming butuh ini.
hotAir.label: Napas hangat

light.description: Pakai suaramu yang lebih lembut dan tinggi - jangan dipaksa
light.label: Ringan & Lembut

lowLarynx.description: Jaga laring tetap turun dan santai. Kalau laring naik, kamu berpindah register, bukan mencapainya.
lowLarynx.label: Laring rendah

noNasalAir.description: Tidak ada yang lewat hidung. Jepit hidungmu sebentar - bunyinya harus sama sekali tidak berubah.
noNasalAir.label: Tanpa udara hidung

open.description: Turunkan rahangmu, seperti sedang menguap sambil bernyanyi
open.label: Penempatan Terbuka

pokerFace.description: Ekspresi kosong dan santai. Mengencangkan wajah adalah tanda tenggorokan ikut mengencang.
pokerFace.label: Poker face

power.description: Bernyanyi lebih keras dari perut, bukan dengan menjepit tenggorokan
power.label: Tenaga

quack.description: Niat bunyi mencicit, hampir seperti mau muntah - tapi laring tetap turun. Niatnya yang penting, bukan bunyinya.
quack.label: Kwek

sovt.description: Nyanyi lewat dengung lembut - seperti humming lewat sedotan
sovt.label: Resonansi

steadySupport.description: Napas perut yang santai dengan tekanan lembut ke bawah. Stabil, tapi jangan pernah terkunci atau mengeras.
steadySupport.label: Support stabil

sustain.description: Tahan tiap nada dengan stabil sepanjang durasinya
sustain.label: Kontrol Napas

tryInhaled.description: Temukan dulu sambil menarik napas. Sensasi itu yang kamu bawa saat mengembuskan napas.
tryInhaled.label: Coba: saat menghirup

tryOctaveUp.description: Bidik nada satu oktaf di atasnya, lalu turunkan dengan santai ke subharmonik. Ini jalan masuk, bukan sesuatu yang ditahan.
tryOctaveUp.label: Coba: naik seoktaf

vocalFry.description: Bunyi rendah yang gemeretak - seperti suaramu baru bangun
vocalFry.label: Vocal Fry

breakFinder.firstBreakExplain: Nyanyi bersama piano. Saat suaramu seperti mau pecah, berpindah ke suara yang lebih ringan, atau kamu harus memaksa lebih keras - itu dia. Ketuk di mana saja di layar.
breakFinder.thisHelpsEstimate: Ini membantu kami memperkirakan peralihan registermu yang kedua.
breakFinder.voiceBreakEducational: Jenis suara juga bergantung pada di mana suaramu terdengar paling bagus dan pada warna suaramu.
breakFinder.voiceBreakExplain: Saat naik makin tinggi, ada titik di mana suaramu seperti mau pecah atau berpindah, seperti pindah gigi. Itulah peralihan registermu. Kami akan memainkan nada yang makin tinggi. Ikut nyanyi saja, lalu ketuk layar saat kamu merasakan perpindahan itu.

listenFor.suddenlyNeedMoreEffort: Tiba-tiba butuh usaha lebih untuk naik
listenFor.voiceFlipsToLighterSound: Suaramu berpindah ke suara yang lebih ringan dan berangin
listenFor.voiceWantsToCrack: Suaramu seperti mau pecah atau putus

range.listenForNotes: Kami akan mendengarkan nada terendahmu, lalu yang tertinggi. Nyanyikan dan tahan tiap nada dengan stabil.
range.mainRangeIsChestAndHead: Ini suara dada dan suara kepalamu - nada yang biasa kamu nyanyikan.
range.rangeBreakMoreReliable: Peralihan register suaramu adalah penanda jenis suara yang lebih andal.
range.rangeMayChange: Jangkauanmu bisa berubah karena pemanasan, latihan, dan waktu dalam sehari.
range.voiceBreakOnboardingDesc: Ini membantu menyusun latihan di sekitar peralihan registermu.

registers.subharmonicSoundingNote: Ini nada yang didengar orang, bukan yang kamu nyanyikan. Ketuk ikon speaker untuk mendengar tiap nada.

blend.description: Suavize a troca entre sua voz grave e a aguda
blend.label: Voz mista

closure.description: Mantenha o som limpo e claro, sem vazar ar
closure.label: Fechamento das pregas

distortion.description: Rouquidão controlada - pense em cantor de rock, não em grito
distortion.label: Distorção

falseCordDrone.description: Chacoalho leve das falsas pregas - móvel pesado sendo arrastado, porta sem óleo se fechando. Um MMMM grave entre M e R, como um motor em marcha lenta. Nunca o som apertado e agudo de furadeira.
falseCordDrone.label: Ronco, não furadeira

forward.description: Sinta o som atrás do nariz, não na garganta
forward.label: Colocação frontal

fryOnset.description: Comece num fry levemente comprimido e depois solte o ataque. É essa soltura que fecha as pregas como um zíper.
fryOnset.label: Ataque em fry

grit.description: Coloque uma borda áspera - como um rosnado baixo por baixo
grit.label: Aspereza

hotAir.description: Solte o ar como quem esquenta as mãos num dia frio. Toda técnica de scream precisa disso.
hotAir.label: Ar quente

light.description: Use sua voz mais leve e aguda - não empurre
light.label: Leve e suave

lowLarynx.description: Mantenha a laringe baixa e relaxada. Se ela subir, você trocou de registro em vez de alcançar um.
lowLarynx.label: Laringe baixa

noNasalAir.description: Nada pelo nariz. Tape ele por um segundo - o som não pode mudar nada.
noNasalAir.label: Sem ar pelo nariz

open.description: Solte a mandíbula, como se bocejasse cantando
open.label: Colocação aberta

pokerFace.description: Expressão parada e relaxada. Apertar o rosto é sinal de que a garganta está apertando também.
pokerFace.label: Rosto neutro

power.description: Cante mais alto vindo da barriga, não apertando a garganta
power.label: Potência

quack.description: Uma intenção esganiçada, quase de engasgo - mas com a laringe embaixo. O que vale é a intenção, não o barulho.
quack.label: Grasnado

sovt.description: Cante por um zumbido suave - como cantarolar dentro de um canudo
sovt.label: Ressonância

steadySupport.description: Respiração abdominal relaxada com uma leve pressão para baixo. Estável, mas nunca travada ou dura.
steadySupport.label: Apoio constante

sustain.description: Segure cada nota firme por toda a duração
sustain.label: Controle de ar

tryInhaled.description: Ache o som inspirando primeiro. É essa sensação que você leva para a versão expirada.
tryInhaled.label: Tente: inspirando

tryOctaveUp.description: Mire a nota uma oitava acima e depois relaxe até o subarmônico. É um caminho de entrada, não algo para segurar.
tryOctaveUp.label: Tente: uma oitava acima

vocalFry.description: Aquele som grave e estalado - como a voz acordando
vocalFry.label: Vocal Fry

breakFinder.firstBreakExplain: Cante junto com o piano. Quando a voz parecer que vai quebrar, virar para um som mais leve, ou você precisar empurrar mais - é ali. Toque em qualquer lugar da tela.
breakFinder.thisHelpsEstimate: Isso ajuda a estimar sua segunda troca de registro.
breakFinder.voiceBreakEducational: O tipo de voz também depende de onde sua voz soa melhor e da qualidade do seu timbre.
breakFinder.voiceBreakExplain: Conforme você sobe, tem um ponto em que a voz quer quebrar ou mudar, como trocar de marcha. Essa é a sua passagem. Vamos tocar notas subindo. Cante junto e toque a tela quando sentir a mudança acontecer.
breakFinder.whatDescribesYourVoice: O que descreve melhor sua voz?

listenFor.suddenlyNeedMoreEffort: De repente dá mais trabalho subir
listenFor.voiceFlipsToLighterSound: Sua voz vira para um som mais leve e soproso
listenFor.voiceWantsToCrack: Sua voz quer quebrar ou falhar

fullJourney.description: Aquecer até a voz de cabeça
fullJourney.name: Trajeto completo

range.goAsHighAsYouCan: Suba o quanto der sem forçar
range.holdUntilCalm: Segure a nota até as ondas se acalmarem
range.listenForNotes: Vamos ouvir sua nota mais grave e depois a mais aguda. É só cantar e segurar cada nota firme.
range.mainRangeIsChestAndHead: Esta é sua voz de peito e de cabeça - as notas que você canta normalmente.
range.rangeBreakMoreReliable: Sua passagem é um indicador mais confiável do tipo de voz.
range.rangeMayChange: Sua extensão muda com o aquecimento, o treino e a hora do dia.
range.rangeTooNarrow: Parece estreita demais - tentar de novo?
range.singHighestNote: Cante sua nota aguda mais confortável
range.singLowestNote: Cante sua nota grave mais confortável
range.voiceBreakOnboardingDesc: Isso ajuda a montar exercícios em volta das suas trocas de registro.

registers.subharmonicSoundingNote: Estas são as notas que as pessoas ouvem, não as que você canta. Toque nos alto-falantes para ouvir cada uma.

smooth.description: Liga as notas com um deslize.
smooth.name: Suave

blend.description: Pes ve tiz sesin arasındaki geçişi yumuşat
blend.label: Miks Ses

closure.description: Sesi temiz ve net tut, hava kaçmasın
closure.label: Tel Kapanışı

distortion.description: Kontrollü kirli ton - bağırmak değil, rock şarkıcısı gibi
distortion.label: Distorsiyon

falseCordDrone.description: Hafif yalancı tel hırıltısı - ağır mobilya sürüklenmesi, yağsız bir kapının kapanışı. M ile R arası pes bir MMMM, rölantideki motor gibi. Asla o sıkışık, tiz matkap sesi değil.
falseCordDrone.label: Uğultu, matkap değil

forward.description: Sesi boğazında değil, burnunun arkasında hisset
forward.label: Öne Yerleştirme

fryOnset.description: Hafifçe sıkıştırılmış bir fry ile başla, sonra atağı bırak. Telleri fermuar gibi kapatan, o bırakıştır.
fryOnset.label: Fry atağı

grit.description: Sesine hafif bir kirlilik kat - altta hafif bir hırlama gibi
grit.label: Kirli Ton

hotAir.description: Soğuk bir günde ellerini ısıtır gibi nefes ver. Her çığlık tekniğinin buna ihtiyacı var.
hotAir.label: Sıcak hava

light.description: Daha yumuşak, tiz sesini kullan - zorlama
light.label: Hafif & Nazik

lowLarynx.description: Gırtlağı aşağıda ve gevşek tut. Yukarı çıkıyorsa notaya ulaşmamış, ses bölgesi değiştirmişsindir.
lowLarynx.label: Alçak gırtlak

noNasalAir.description: Burundan hiçbir şey geçmesin. Bir saniye burnunu kapat - ses hiç değişmemeli.
noNasalAir.label: Burundan hava yok

open.description: Çeneni bırak, şarkı söylerken esniyormuş gibi
open.label: Açık Yerleştirme

pokerFace.description: İfadesiz, gevşek bir yüz. Yüzünü sıkıyorsan boğazın da sıkılıyor demektir.
pokerFace.label: Poker suratı

power.description: Boğazını sıkarak değil, karnından daha gür söyle
power.label: Güç

quack.description: Cıyaklayan, neredeyse öğürür gibi bir niyet - ama gırtlak aşağıda kalarak. Önemli olan niyet, çıkan gürültü değil.
quack.label: Ördek sesi

sovt.description: Yumuşak bir vızıltıyla söyle - pipetten mırıldanır gibi
sovt.label: Rezonans

steadySupport.description: Karından gevşek nefes, hafif bir aşağı basınç. Sabit, ama asla kilitli ya da kasılı değil.
steadySupport.label: Sabit destek

sustain.description: Her notayı süresi boyunca sabit tut
sustain.label: Nefes Kontrolü

tryInhaled.description: Önce nefes alırken bul. Nefes verirkenki haline taşıyacağın şey o histir.
tryInhaled.label: Dene: nefes alarak

tryOctaveUp.description: Önce bir oktav yukarıdaki notayı hedefle, sonra gevşetip subharmoniğe indir. Bir giriş yolu, tutulacak bir şey değil.
tryOctaveUp.label: Dene: oktav yukarı

vocalFry.description: O cızırtılı, pes ses - sesin uyanıyormuş gibi
vocalFry.label: Vokal Fry

breakFinder.firstBreakExplain: Piyanoyla birlikte söyle. Sesin çatlamak istediğinde, daha hafif bir tona kaydığında ya da daha çok zorlaman gerektiğinde, işte orası. Ekranda herhangi bir yere dokun.
breakFinder.thisHelpsEstimate: Bu, ikinci ses bölgesi geçişini tahmin etmemize yardımcı olur.
breakFinder.voiceBreakEducational: Ses türü, sesinin en iyi tınladığı bölgeye ve ses rengine de bağlıdır.
breakFinder.voiceBreakExplain: Tizlere çıktıkça sesinin çatlamak ya da değişmek istediği bir nokta gelir, vites değiştirmek gibi. İşte orası senin geçiş bölgen. Yukarı doğru notalar çalacağız. Sen birlikte söyle ve o değişimi hissettiğin an ekrana dokun.

listenFor.suddenlyNeedMoreEffort: Tizlere çıkmak birden daha çok çaba istiyor
listenFor.voiceFlipsToLighterSound: Sesin daha hafif, daha nefesli bir tona geçiyor
listenFor.voiceWantsToCrack: Sesin çatlamak ya da kırılmak istiyor

range.listenForNotes: Önce en pes, sonra en tiz notanı dinleyeceğiz. Sadece söyle ve her notayı sabit tut.
range.mainRangeIsChestAndHead: Bu senin göğüs ve kafa sesin - normalde söylediğin notalar.
range.rangeBreakMoreReliable: Geçiş bölgen, ses türü için daha güvenilir bir göstergedir.
range.rangeMayChange: Ses aralığın ısınmayla, çalışmayla ve günün saatiyle değişebilir.
range.rangeTooNarrow: Bu çok dar görünüyor - tekrar deneyelim mi?
range.singHighestNote: Rahat söyleyebildiğin en tiz notayı söyle
range.singLowestNote: Rahat söyleyebildiğin en pes notayı söyle
range.voiceBreakOnboardingDesc: Bu, egzersizleri ses bölgesi geçişlerine göre kurmamıza yardımcı olur.
range.wantToFindVoiceBreak: Geçiş bölgeni de bulmak ister misin?

registers.subharmonicSoundingNote: Bunlar dinleyenin duyduğu notalar, senin söylediklerin değil. Her birini duymak için hoparlörlere dokun.
